senses.zh: bài đánh giá; bài phê bình
senses.en: An account giving an opinion of a book, product, or performance.

senses.zh: sự xem xét; sự rà soát
senses.en: A careful examination to assess something or consider changes.

senses.zh: xem xét; ôn tập; đánh giá
senses.en: To examine, study again, or give an opinion about something.

ex.en: Her review convinced me to read the whole novel.
Governments should regularly review housing policies to ensure that affordable accommodation remains available to low-income families.

col: write a review｜viết bài đánh giá
a thorough review｜đợt rà soát toàn diện
review a policy｜xem xét lại một chính sách
review your notes｜ôn lại ghi chú
tip: Với nghĩa ôn bài, Anh-Mỹ thường dùng review, Anh-Anh thường dùng revise.

senses.zh: đường cao tốc; đường quốc lộ
senses.en: a main public road connecting towns or cities

ex.en: We followed the highway along the coast until sunset.
Building a new highway may reduce travel times but also damage nearby wildlife habitats.

col: highway construction｜xây dựng đường cao tốc
highway maintenance｜bảo trì đường cao tốc
tip: Thường gặp trong Anh-Mỹ; không nhất thiết là đường cao tốc khép kín.

senses.zh: cuộc khảo sát; cuộc thăm dò ý kiến
senses.en: A study that collects information by asking people questions.
Collect information by asking people questions.

senses.zh: đo đạc; khảo sát (đất đai, công trình)
senses.en: Examine and measure land or buildings in detail.

ex.en: I completed a short survey about our local library.
A recent survey suggests that many commuters would cycle more often if safer routes were available.

col: conduct a survey｜tiến hành khảo sát
survey respondents｜người trả lời khảo sát
survey the land｜đo đạc đất đai
tip: Danh từ nhấn trọng âm ở âm tiết đầu, động từ nhấn ở âm tiết cuối.

senses.en: To need something for a particular purpose
To make something necessary through a rule or instruction

ex.en: These plants require plenty of sunlight and regular watering.
Governments should require manufacturers to provide clear instructions for repairing products rather than replacing them.

col: be required to do something｜được yêu cầu làm gì
require further investigation｜cần điều tra thêm
tip: require sb to do sth nghĩa là yêu cầu ai làm gì.

senses.en: how you think or feel about someone or something

ex.en: His cheerful attitude makes even rainy mornings feel brighter.
Schools can encourage a positive attitude towards learning by giving students constructive feedback rather than constant criticism.

col: change of attitude｜sự thay đổi thái độ
public attitudes｜thái độ của công chúng
tip: Thái độ đối với điều gì thường dùng attitude to hoặc towards.

senses.en: To usually behave in a particular way.
To look after someone or something.

ex.en: I tend to feel sleepy after a big lunch.
People tend to use public transport more frequently when services are reliable, affordable, and easy to access.

col: tend to do something｜thường làm gì
tend to the injured｜chăm sóc người bị thương
tip: tend to do nghĩa là thường làm gì; tend to someone nghĩa là chăm sóc ai.

senses.en: Sea animals, especially shellfish, eaten as food.

ex.en: We bought fresh seafood at the harbour this morning.
Demand for sustainable seafood has encouraged some fishing communities to adopt methods that cause less damage to marine ecosystems.

col: a seafood restaurant｜nhà hàng hải sản
tip: Thường là danh từ không đếm được; một đĩa hải sản nói a plate of seafood.

senses.en: A product name identifying the company that makes it
To describe someone publicly as having a particular bad quality

ex.en: Which brand of toothpaste do you usually buy?
Consumers may choose a familiar brand even when cheaper alternatives offer similar quality.

col: brand loyalty｜lòng trung thành với thương hiệu
a leading brand｜thương hiệu hàng đầu
brand someone as｜gán cho ai cái mác
tip: brand là thương hiệu; trademark nhấn mạnh nhãn hiệu được pháp luật bảo hộ.

senses.en: To become tired or make someone feel tired
To lose interest in someone or something
A rubber covering fitted around a vehicle's wheel

ex.en: Long walks tire my grandfather, so we stop often.
Students may tire of repetitive exercises unless teachers introduce varied activities that encourage active participation.

tip: Động từ tire dùng chung ở cả Anh và Mỹ; lốp xe viết là tyre trong Anh-Anh.

senses.en: A vegetable with long, crisp stalks, eaten raw or cooked.

ex.en: I chopped some celery and added it to the soup.
Growing vegetables such as celery locally can reduce transport costs and provide communities with fresh produce.

col: a stalk of celery｜một cọng cần tây
tip: Thường không đếm được; một cọng cần tây nói a stalk of celery.

senses.en: The place where something is or where something happens.
A place outside a studio where filming takes place.

ex.en: This cafe has a lovely location beside the river.
The location of affordable housing strongly influences residents' access to schools, healthcare, and employment opportunities.

tip: on location nghĩa là quay ngoài trường quay, tại hiện trường.

senses.zh: bảng câu hỏi; phiếu điều tra
senses.en: A set of written questions used to collect information from people.

ex.en: Please complete this short questionnaire before leaving the clinic.
Researchers distributed a questionnaire to investigate how commuting time affects workers' wellbeing and satisfaction with their jobs.

col: complete a questionnaire｜điền bảng câu hỏi
design a questionnaire｜thiết kế bảng câu hỏi
distribute a questionnaire｜phát bảng câu hỏi
questionnaire responses｜câu trả lời trong bảng câu hỏi
tip: Viết hai chữ n, trọng âm ở cuối; survey là cuộc khảo sát, questionnaire chỉ là công cụ.

senses.en: the soft organ in your mouth used for tasting and speaking
a language used by a particular community

ex.en: I burned my tongue on the hot soup.
Children who receive early education in their mother tongue may develop stronger foundations for learning other languages.

col: bite your tongue｜kiềm chế không nói
on the tip of your tongue｜nhớ mà không nói ra được
tip: Nghĩa ngôn ngữ thường gặp trong các cụm như mother tongue.

senses.en: a small attached piece giving information about something
to attach information to something for identification
to describe someone or something in a particular way

ex.en: Check the label before you wash your new sweater.
Schools should avoid labelling children as failures, since this can damage their confidence and motivation.

col: label someone as｜gán cho ai là
tip: Quá khứ Anh-Anh là labelled, Anh-Mỹ thường dùng labeled.

senses.en: A wheeled cart used for carrying shopping or other items.
An electric passenger vehicle that runs on rails in streets.

ex.en: She pushed a trolley full of groceries towards the checkout.
Airports should provide free luggage trolleys to make travelling easier for families and older passengers.

tip: Anh-Anh dùng trolley cho xe đẩy mua sắm, Anh-Mỹ thường dùng shopping cart.

senses.en: to move or do something very quickly, often without care

senses.zh: sự vội vã; giờ cao điểm
senses.en: a state of hurry or a period of intense activity
a sudden strong feeling or flow of something

ex.en: I rushed downstairs when I heard the doorbell.
Governments should not rush major transport projects without first assessing their environmental and financial impacts.

col: rush into a decision｜vội vàng quyết định
a rush of excitement｜một cơn phấn khích dâng trào
tip: rush to do nghĩa là vội làm; rush into nghĩa là hành động vội vàng.

senses.en: a place where someone can live or stay

senses.zh: sự thỏa hiệp; sự dàn xếp
senses.en: an arrangement that meets different needs or settles a disagreement

ex.en: We found cheap accommodation near the beach last summer.
Universities should provide affordable accommodation so that students from disadvantaged backgrounds can study without excessive financial pressure.

col: student accommodation｜chỗ ở cho sinh viên
affordable accommodation｜chỗ ở giá phải chăng
reach an accommodation｜đạt được thỏa hiệp
tip: Trong Anh-Anh, nghĩa chỗ ở thường không đếm được; chú ý viết hai chữ c và hai chữ m.

senses.en: Gold, jewels, or other highly valuable objects
Something greatly valued for its beauty, importance, or personal meaning
To value something deeply and care for it

ex.en: The children imagined finding treasure inside the old chest.
Museums preserve cultural treasures so that future generations can understand the achievements and traditions of earlier societies.

tip: Chỉ chung châu báu thì không đếm được; một báu vật cụ thể thì đếm được.

senses.en: to feel sorry about something that happened or was done

senses.zh: sự hối tiếc; sự nuối tiếc
senses.en: sadness about a past action, decision, or situation

ex.en: I regret leaving my umbrella at home this morning.
Graduates may regret choosing a career solely for its salary if the work provides little personal satisfaction.

col: regret doing something｜hối tiếc đã làm gì
deep regret｜nỗi tiếc nuối sâu sắc
express regret｜bày tỏ sự tiếc nuối
regret to inform｜rất tiếc phải thông báo
tip: regret doing là hối tiếc vì đã làm; regret to say là tiếc phải nói.

senses.en: to make clothing or fabric by looping yarn with needles
to join closely together or heal into one piece

ex.en: My grandfather knitted a warm scarf for me.
Community groups that knit blankets for local shelters combine practical support with opportunities for social interaction.

col: knit together｜gắn kết chặt chẽ; liền lại
tip: Chữ k không phát âm; quá khứ và phân từ quá khứ có thể là knitted hoặc knit.

senses.en: a performer who wears funny clothes and makes people laugh
someone who behaves foolishly to make others laugh
to behave playfully or foolishly to amuse others

ex.en: The clown made a tiny dog from a balloon.
A trained clown can help young patients feel more comfortable during their stay in hospital.

tip: clown around nghĩa là làm trò mua vui; gọi ai là clown có thể mang ý chê.

senses.en: A small, round, dark blue fruit.

ex.en: A ripe blueberry rolled off my spoon onto the table.
Growing blueberries locally can diversify farm income, but suitable soil conditions are essential for successful cultivation.

tip: Danh từ đếm được; số nhiều đổi y thành ies: blueberries.

senses.en: the quality of caring about others and helping them

senses.zh: hành động tử tế; ơn huệ
senses.en: an act that helps someone or shows care

ex.en: Her kindness made our new neighbour feel welcome.
Schools can encourage kindness by giving students opportunities to support classmates who face personal difficulties.

col: an act of kindness｜một hành động tử tế
kindness towards others｜lòng tốt đối với người khác
tip: Phẩm chất tử tế thì không đếm được; một hành động tử tế cụ thể thì đếm được.

senses.en: Water falling from a height over a steep rock face

ex.en: We could hear the waterfall long before we saw it.
Tourism near a waterfall can support local businesses, but visitor facilities should protect the surrounding natural habitat.

col: a spectacular waterfall｜một thác nước hùng vĩ
the base of a waterfall｜chân thác
a cascading waterfall｜thác nước đổ xuống
tip: Danh từ đếm được: một thác nước là a waterfall.

senses.en: containing spices, often with a strong, hot flavour

ex.en: The noodles were too spicy, so I ordered rice.
Traditional spicy dishes can attract visitors who want to experience the distinctive flavours of a region.

tip: spicy nghĩa là nhiều gia vị hoặc cay; hot cũng có thể nghĩa là nóng.

senses.en: Official permission to enter or stay in a foreign country.

ex.en: My student visa arrived just before the flight.
Simpler visa procedures can encourage international students to study abroad and contribute to local economies.

tip: visa là thị thực, passport là hộ chiếu; thường phải có hộ chiếu mới xin được visa.

senses.en: A team sport involving carrying, passing, and kicking an oval ball

ex.en: My brother plays rugby every Saturday with his friends.
Schools offering rugby should provide suitable coaching and safety equipment to reduce the risk of injuries.

tip: Thường chỉ môn rugby kiểu Anh, không giống bóng bầu dục kiểu Mỹ.

senses.en: A device connecting electrical equipment to a power socket.
An object fitted into a hole to stop liquid escaping.
To fill or block a hole or gap.

ex.en: Pull the plug out before you clean the toaster.
Households can reduce some unnecessary electricity consumption by removing plugs from sockets when appliances are not in use.

col: pull out the plug｜rút phích cắm
plug something in｜cắm điện cho thứ gì
plug a gap｜lấp một chỗ trống
tip: plug là phích cắm, socket là ổ cắm; plug in nghĩa là cắm điện.

senses.en: To stay on a liquid's surface or move gently through air.
To suggest an idea for others to consider.
A decorated vehicle used in a parade.

ex.en: A yellow leaf floated gently across the garden pond.
Researchers have floated the idea of using artificial islands to provide additional housing in crowded coastal cities.

col: float on water｜nổi trên mặt nước
float an idea｜đưa ra một ý tưởng
tip: float an idea nghĩa là đưa ý tưởng ra thảo luận, chưa thực hiện.

senses.en: a small insect or similar creature
an error in a computer program that causes problems
to annoy someone, especially repeatedly

ex.en: A tiny green bug landed on my sleeve.
A software bug can disrupt essential services, highlighting the importance of thorough testing before release.

col: a tiny bug｜một con bọ nhỏ xíu
tip: Trong khẩu ngữ, bug có thể chỉ côn trùng nhỏ; trong công nghệ thường là lỗi chương trình.

senses.en: Biological classification based on reproductive and other physical characteristics.
Physical activity involving sexual intimacy.
To identify the biological sex of an animal.

ex.en: The vet checked the sex of our new kitten.
Researchers examined whether biological sex influenced participants' responses to the treatment in the clinical study.

col: sex differences｜sự khác biệt giới tính
determine the sex｜xác định giới tính
tip: sex thiên về giới tính sinh học; gender thường thiên về giới tính xã hội.

senses.en: A tiny infectious agent that reproduces inside living cells
Harmful computer code that spreads by infecting files or programs

ex.en: The doctor said a virus was causing my cough.
Public health campaigns can limit the spread of a virus by encouraging vaccination and regular handwashing.

tip: virus là vi-rút, bacterium là vi khuẩn; không dùng lẫn lộn.

senses.en: simple, without decoration or a pattern
easy to see or understand
a large area of flat land

ex.en: She chose a plain white shirt for the interview.
Public health advice should use plain language so that everyone can understand essential information.

col: a coastal plain｜đồng bằng ven biển
tip: plain có thể chỉ không có hoa văn; đồng bằng là danh từ plain.

senses.en: A change or result caused by something.
To bring about a change or result.

ex.en: The new curtains had a calming effect on the room.
Higher parking charges may have little effect on traffic unless reliable public transport is also available.

col: have an effect on｜có ảnh hưởng đến
effect change｜tạo ra sự thay đổi
tip: effect thường là danh từ; affect thường là động từ nghĩa là ảnh hưởng.

senses.en: Without being prevented or affected by something.

ex.en: We enjoyed our walk despite the cold wind.
Despite significant investment in public transport, many commuters still prefer driving because services remain unreliable.

col: despite the fact that｜mặc dù thực tế là
tip: Theo sau là danh từ hoặc danh động từ, không thêm of; theo sau là mệnh đề thì dùng the fact that.

senses.en: A vehicle designed to travel through space.

ex.en: The children built a spaceship from cardboard boxes.
Designing a spaceship for long journeys requires careful planning to protect astronauts from radiation and isolation.

col: board a spaceship｜lên tàu vũ trụ
launch a spaceship｜phóng tàu vũ trụ
aboard a spaceship｜trên tàu vũ trụ
tip: spaceship đếm được; spacecraft có dạng số ít và số nhiều giống nhau.

senses.en: to stop someone speaking or working by doing something
to stop an activity or process for a time

ex.en: Please don't interrupt me while I explain the rules.
Frequent phone notifications can interrupt students' concentration and reduce the amount they learn during independent study.

col: interrupt a conversation｜ngắt lời cuộc trò chuyện
tip: interrupt là cắt ngang giữa chừng; disrupt nhấn mạnh làm rối loạn tiến trình bình thường.

senses.en: A literary work using carefully arranged language, often in lines.

ex.en: Leila read a short poem aloud after dinner.
Reading a poem from another culture can help students explore unfamiliar perspectives and develop sensitivity to language.

col: recite a poem｜đọc thuộc lòng một bài thơ
tip: poem đếm được, chỉ một bài thơ; poetry không đếm được, chỉ thơ ca nói chung.

senses.en: having a firm shape rather than being liquid or gas
strong, dependable, or based on good evidence
a substance that keeps its shape rather than flowing

ex.en: The lake froze solid during the bitterly cold night.
Governments need solid evidence before introducing policies that could significantly affect public health and household spending.

tip: solid làm danh từ là chất rắn; solid evidence nghĩa là bằng chứng đáng tin.

senses.en: To formally ask for a job, place, or permission
To use something practically, or be relevant to a situation
To spread a substance onto a surface

ex.en: Apply sunscreen before you go outside on sunny days.
Universities should encourage students from disadvantaged backgrounds to apply for scholarships that cover tuition and living expenses.

col: apply to a university｜nộp đơn vào đại học
tip: apply for + việc xin; apply to + cơ quan hoặc đối tượng áp dụng.

senses.en: To cut or grip with teeth, or wound with mouthparts

senses.zh: miếng cắn; vết cắn; một miếng
senses.en: An act of biting, its wound, or a mouthful of food

ex.en: She bit into the apple and smiled at its sweetness.
Public health campaigns should explain how travellers can prevent mosquito bites in regions with tropical diseases.

col: bite into an apple｜cắn vào quả táo
tip: Quá khứ là bit, phân từ quá khứ là bitten; một miếng ăn nói a bite.

senses.en: happening immediately, without any delay
prepared very quickly, usually by adding hot water
an extremely short period of time

ex.en: The warm soup brought instant comfort after our walk.
Digital platforms provide instant access to educational resources, although reliable internet connections remain essential.

tip: Tính từ instant nghĩa là tức thì; in an instant nghĩa là trong chốc lát.

senses.en: a judgement formed after considering facts or evidence
the final part or ending of something

ex.en: We reached the same conclusion after checking the receipts.
Researchers should consider alternative explanations before drawing a conclusion from a relatively small sample.

col: reach a conclusion｜đi đến kết luận
draw a conclusion｜rút ra kết luận
tip: “Rút ra kết luận” dùng reach hoặc draw a conclusion, không dùng make.

senses.en: the amount or number of something

ex.en: We bought a large quantity of rice yesterday.
Reducing the quantity of food wasted by households could lower both environmental damage and living costs.

col: a large quantity of｜một lượng lớn
in small quantities｜với số lượng nhỏ
quality over quantity｜chất lượng hơn số lượng
tip: quantity là số lượng, quality là chất lượng; a quantity of có thể đi với cả hai loại danh từ.

senses.en: to cause physical harm to a person or animal

ex.en: You could injure your back lifting that heavy box.
Employers should provide safety training to reduce the risk of workers injuring themselves while operating machinery.

col: injure your knee｜làm bị thương đầu gối
injure yourself｜tự làm mình bị thương
tip: injure thường chỉ bị thương ở cơ thể; làm hỏng đồ vật dùng damage.

senses.zh: nghệ sĩ dương cầm; người chơi piano
senses.en: Someone who plays the piano, especially professionally.

ex.en: The pianist smiled before playing her favourite song.
A professional pianist usually needs years of disciplined practice as well as opportunities to perform publicly.

col: concert pianist｜nghệ sĩ dương cầm hòa nhạc
professional pianist｜nghệ sĩ dương cầm chuyên nghiệp
tip: pianist chỉ người chơi; cây đàn là piano.

senses.en: To say that something is wrong or unsatisfactory

ex.en: Our neighbours often complain about noise from the traffic.
Residents may complain to local authorities when construction work repeatedly disrupts their sleep and daily activities.

col: complain about noise｜phàn nàn về tiếng ồn
complain to the manager｜khiếu nại với quản lý
tip: Khiếu nại với ai về việc gì: complain to sb about sth.

senses.en: A job requiring specialist knowledge and usually advanced training.
All the people working in a particular specialist occupation.
An open statement of a belief, feeling, or intention.

ex.en: Nursing is a demanding profession, but my sister loves it.
The teaching profession needs greater public support to attract talented graduates and retain experienced staff.

col: enter a profession｜bước vào một nghề
a profession of faith｜lời tuyên xưng đức tin
tip: profession thường chỉ nghề đòi hỏi đào tạo chuyên môn, hẹp hơn job.

senses.en: A practice combining body positions, controlled breathing, and mental focus.

ex.en: She does yoga on a mat beside the window.
Offering yoga classes in community centres may help residents manage stress and maintain flexibility.

tip: Tập yoga dùng do hoặc practise yoga, không dùng play.

senses.en: A circular road junction where traffic travels around a central island.
Not following the most direct route or way of speaking.
A rotating platform that children sit or stand on.

ex.en: Take the second exit at the roundabout near the park.
Replacing a busy junction with a roundabout may improve traffic flow and reduce serious collisions.

col: take a roundabout route｜đi đường vòng
in a roundabout way｜theo cách vòng vo
tip: Làm tính từ chỉ sự không trực tiếp, như a roundabout answer.

senses.en: An area of sea partly enclosed by land.

senses.zh: ô; khu riêng (chỗ đỗ xe, khoang)
senses.en: A designated space within a building or parking area.

ex.en: Small fishing boats floated in the sheltered bay.
Coastal development around the bay must be carefully managed to protect marine habitats and local livelihoods.

tip: bay chủ yếu là vịnh; trong bối cảnh đỗ xe hoặc bốc dỡ hàng, chỉ khu vực riêng.

senses.en: Behave or feel in response to something that happens.
Change chemically when combined with another substance.

ex.en: How did your sister react to the surprise party?
Governments must react quickly to public health emergencies while providing clear information to citizens.

col: react to news｜phản ứng trước tin tức
react with oxygen｜phản ứng với ô-xi
tip: Phản ứng trước điều gì dùng react to; phản ứng với chất nào dùng react with.

senses.en: A curved object used for hanging, holding or catching things.
To attach or catch something with a hook.

ex.en: Hang your wet coat on the hook by the door.
Installing a simple hook beside each desk can keep school bags off classroom floors and reduce accidents.

tip: be hooked on nghĩa là nghiện, mê mẩn, không phải bị móc thật sự.

senses.en: Having an uneven surface that is not smooth.
Not exact, detailed, or completely finished.
Difficult to experience, or involving strong, uncontrolled movement or force.

ex.en: The rough wooden bench scratched my bare legs.
A rough estimate of construction costs can help local authorities decide whether a housing project is affordable.

col: a rough surface｜bề mặt thô ráp
a rough estimate｜ước lượng sơ bộ
a rough time｜quãng thời gian khó khăn
tip: rough estimate là ước tính sơ bộ; gh trong rough đọc là /f/.

senses.en: Not accurate, true, or right.

ex.en: The delivery failed because our address details were incorrect.
Incorrect information shared online can undermine public understanding of health issues and influence important personal decisions.

col: factually incorrect｜sai về mặt sự thật
tip: incorrect trang trọng hơn wrong, thường dùng với đáp án, thông tin hoặc dữ liệu.

senses.zh: về thể chất; về mặt cơ thể
senses.en: In a way related to the body or physical effort.
In a real, material way rather than virtually or theoretically.

ex.en: After moving those boxes, I felt physically exhausted.
Physically active children often develop healthier habits that continue into adulthood, reducing their risk of chronic disease.

col: physically demanding｜đòi hỏi nhiều thể lực
tip: Khi nhấn mạnh khía cạnh cơ thể, thường đối lập với mentally.

senses.zh: trong khi đó; trong lúc ấy
senses.en: During the same time or while something else is happening.

ex.en: The soup is simmering; meanwhile, I will prepare dessert.
New railway lines may take years to complete; meanwhile, cities should improve existing bus services.

col: in the meanwhile｜trong khoảng thời gian đó
meanwhile, elsewhere｜trong khi đó, ở nơi khác
tip: Khi nối hai câu hoàn chỉnh, trước đó dùng dấu chấm hoặc dấu chấm phẩy.

senses.en: completely or entirely
when everything or everyone is counted
when considering everything

ex.en: We stopped going to that crowded café altogether.
Although online courses improve access, they cannot altogether replace the social benefits of classroom learning.

col: not altogether clear｜không hoàn toàn rõ ràng
tip: altogether nghĩa là hoàn toàn hoặc tổng cộng; all together nghĩa là tất cả cùng nhau.

senses.en: something you want or plan to achieve
to intend or try to achieve something
to point something towards a particular target

ex.en: My main aim today is to tidy the kitchen.
The programme aims to reduce youth unemployment by providing practical training and opportunities to gain workplace experience.

col: aim to do something｜cố gắng làm gì
with the aim of｜nhằm mục đích
aim at a target｜nhắm vào mục tiêu
tip: aim to do nghĩa là dự định làm; aim at doing nghĩa là nhắm tới việc đạt được.

senses.en: Extremely good or enjoyable.
Very great in amount, degree, or intensity.

ex.en: You did a terrific job fixing that old bicycle.
Community gardens offer a terrific opportunity for residents to exercise outdoors while developing stronger social connections.

tip: Thường dùng khen trong khẩu ngữ; đừng nhầm với terrible nghĩa là tồi tệ.

senses.en: mostly, or more than anything else

ex.en: This little shop mainly sells fresh bread and cakes.
Many rural communities depend mainly on agriculture, making them particularly vulnerable to changes in weather patterns.

col: depend mainly on｜chủ yếu dựa vào
tip: Có nghĩa “chủ yếu chứ không phải toàn bộ”; thường đặt trước động từ chính.

senses.en: to become aware of a fact or understand a situation

senses.zh: thực hiện; biến thành hiện thực
senses.en: to make a hope, ambition, or possibility become real

ex.en: I suddenly realised my keys were still inside the house.
Many students realise the importance of time management when they begin balancing academic work with paid employment.

col: realise the importance of｜nhận thức được tầm quan trọng của
realise an ambition｜thực hiện tham vọng
realise your potential｜phát huy tiềm năng của bạn
tip: Anh-Anh thường viết realise, Anh-Mỹ viết realize; có thể đi với mệnh đề that.

senses.zh: đội ngũ nhân viên; nhân sự
senses.en: The people employed by an organisation.
To provide workers for an organisation or service.

ex.en: The hotel staff helped us carry our heavy bags.
Hospitals need sufficient staff to maintain high standards of care during periods of increased demand.

col: a member of staff｜một nhân viên
tip: Nói một nhân viên dùng a member of staff, không nói a staff.

senses.en: a small shallow dish placed underneath a cup

ex.en: She placed a biscuit on the saucer beside her cup.
Traditional tea sets, including matching cups and saucers, can reflect local craftsmanship and cultural preferences.

col: cup and saucer｜tách và đĩa lót
tip: saucer là đĩa nhỏ lót dưới tách; flying saucer là đĩa bay.

senses.zh: tiệc đứng; bữa ăn tự chọn
senses.en: A meal where people serve themselves from dishes set out.

senses.zh: quầy ăn nhanh ở ga; toa ăn
senses.en: A small place selling refreshments at a station or on a train.

ex.en: We helped ourselves to fresh fruit at the breakfast buffet.
Hotels can reduce food waste by offering smaller portions and replenishing buffet dishes more frequently.

col: a buffet breakfast｜bữa sáng tự chọn
a buffet lunch｜bữa trưa tự chọn
a buffet car｜toa ăn trên tàu
a cold buffet｜tiệc buffet đồ nguội
tip: Nghĩa “tiệc buffet” thì t cuối không phát âm; động từ “đánh mạnh” đọc là /ˈbʌfɪt/.

senses.en: A raised outdoor platform attached to a building, with a railing.
An upper level of seats in a theatre.

ex.en: She grows herbs in small pots on her balcony.
Apartments with a balcony offer residents valuable outdoor space, particularly in cities where public gardens are scarce.

tip: Ở trên ban công dùng on the balcony, không dùng in.

senses.zh: phim tài liệu; chương trình tài liệu
senses.en: A film or programme presenting facts about real subjects.

senses.zh: thuộc tài liệu; bằng văn bản
senses.en: Consisting of or supported by written documents.

ex.en: We watched a documentary about penguins after dinner.
A well-researched documentary can raise public awareness of environmental problems without oversimplifying their causes.

col: documentary evidence｜bằng chứng bằng văn bản
documentary about wildlife｜phim tài liệu về động vật hoang dã
tip: Làm danh từ chỉ phim tài liệu; documentary evidence nghĩa là bằng chứng bằng văn bản.

senses.en: To experience physical pain or mental distress.
To experience something harmful or become worse.

ex.en: I suffer from headaches when I skip lunch.
Small businesses often suffer financial losses when major roadworks prevent customers from reaching their premises.

col: suffer from headaches｜bị đau đầu hành hạ
suffer badly｜bị ảnh hưởng nặng nề
tip: Bệnh tật thường dùng suffer from; tổn thất, hư hại thường đi thẳng sau suffer.

senses.en: Thin metal drawn into strands, often used to carry electricity.
To install or connect electrical wires in something.

ex.en: A thin wire connects the lamp to its battery.
Older buildings often need new electrical wire to meet modern safety standards and support increased energy use.

col: wire up a house｜lắp dây điện cho một ngôi nhà
tip: wire có thể là một sợi dây kim loại; cable thường dày hơn hoặc gồm nhiều sợi.

senses.en: With great force, intensity, or conviction.

ex.en: I strongly recommend taking a jacket on this walk.
Many residents strongly oppose the proposed airport expansion because they fear increased noise and air pollution.

col: strongly associated with｜có liên hệ chặt chẽ với
tip: Thường bổ nghĩa cho recommend, oppose, believe để nhấn mạnh thái độ.

senses.en: making you feel calm and free from stress

ex.en: A warm bath is wonderfully relaxing after a busy day.
Access to relaxing green spaces may improve mental wellbeing among residents of densely populated urban areas.

col: relaxing atmosphere｜bầu không khí thư giãn
tip: relaxing mô tả điều giúp thư giãn; relaxed mô tả người đang thư giãn.

senses.en: not sure about something
not known, settled, or predictable

ex.en: I felt uncertain about which jacket to buy.
The long-term effects of remote working remain uncertain, particularly for younger employees entering the labour market.

col: an uncertain future｜tương lai bất định
tip: Người không chắc dùng uncertain about; việc chưa rõ dùng remain uncertain.

senses.en: To move below a surface, or make something do this.
A fixed basin with taps and a drain for washing.
To fall to a lower level or become weaker.

ex.en: The little toy boat sank beneath the bathwater.
Coastal communities face increasing risks as land sinks and sea levels rise because of climate change.

col: sink to the bottom｜chìm xuống đáy
sink into debt｜lún sâu vào nợ nần
tip: Động từ bất quy tắc: sink, sank, sunk.

senses.en: the activity of buying and selling goods or services
to buy, sell, or exchange goods or services
a skilled job, especially one involving practical work

ex.en: At lunch, I traded my apple for a pear.
International trade can create employment, but governments must ensure that workers receive fair wages and adequate protection.

tip: trade A for B nghĩa là đổi A lấy B; by trade nghĩa là xét về nghề nghiệp.

senses.en: connected with the place or language of someone's early life
living or growing naturally in a particular region

senses.zh: người bản xứ; người sinh ra ở một nơi
senses.en: a person born in a particular place

ex.en: After years abroad, Ravi returned to his native city.
Planting native species in urban gardens can support local wildlife and reduce the need for additional watering.

col: be native to｜có nguồn gốc từ
tip: a native of nghĩa là người sinh ở nơi nào đó; the natives có thể mang sắc thái miệt thị.

senses.en: A place where people are kept as punishment for crimes.
The state of being kept in a prison.

ex.en: The old prison has become a popular local museum.
Education programmes in prison can help individuals develop skills that support their successful return to society.

tip: in prison nghĩa là đang chịu án tù; in the prison nhấn mạnh ở bên trong nhà tù.

senses.zh: việc lên máy bay, tàu, xe
senses.en: The process of getting onto an aircraft, ship, or other vehicle.

senses.zh: ăn ở nội trú; nội trú
senses.en: Staying somewhere with meals provided, especially at school.
Wooden boards used together to cover a surface.

ex.en: We bought some sandwiches before boarding began this morning.
Airports can reduce boarding delays by providing clearer instructions and additional assistance for passengers with limited mobility.

col: priority boarding｜lên máy bay ưu tiên
tip: Danh từ chỉ quá trình lên máy bay, tàu xe; cũng là phân từ hiện tại của board.

senses.en: a musical drama in which performers sing most words

ex.en: We watched an opera at the theatre last night.
Public funding for opera can preserve artistic traditions while making performances accessible to a wider audience.

col: perform an opera｜biểu diễn một vở ô-pê-ra
tip: Chỉ loại hình nghệ thuật nói chung thì không đếm được; một vở dùng an opera.

senses.en: Having many connected parts and being difficult to understand.

senses.zh: khu liên hợp; quần thể công trình
senses.en: A group of buildings used for related activities.

ex.en: This recipe looks complex, but each step is simple.
Urban poverty is a complex issue that requires cooperation between governments, businesses and local communities.

col: sports complex｜khu liên hợp thể thao
tip: Làm tính từ nghĩa là phức tạp; làm danh từ có thể chỉ quần thể công trình.

senses.en: to run or move after someone to catch them

senses.zh: theo đuổi; ra sức giành lấy
senses.en: to try hard to obtain something you want
an attempt to catch someone by following them

ex.en: Our puppy chased a leaf across the garden.
Many young professionals chase higher salaries rather than seek work that offers lasting satisfaction.

col: chase a dream｜theo đuổi ước mơ
a high-speed chase｜cuộc rượt đuổi tốc độ cao
tip: chase có thể đi thẳng với đối tượng, hoặc dùng chase after.

senses.en: A level of a building.

ex.en: Their new house has two storeys and a small garden.
Buildings with many storeys can accommodate more residents without requiring additional land in crowded cities.

col: a two-storey house｜ngôi nhà hai tầng
a multi-storey building｜tòa nhà nhiều tầng
tip: Số nhiều trong Anh-Anh là storeys; Anh-Mỹ viết là story.

senses.en: The distance from one side of something to the other.

ex.en: Check the width of the sofa before buying it.
Increasing the width of pavements can improve accessibility for wheelchair users and make walking more comfortable.

tip: Tính từ là wide, danh từ là width, động từ là widen.

senses.zh: chủ lao động; đơn vị tuyển dụng
senses.en: A person or organisation that pays people to work.

ex.en: My employer lets me work from home on Fridays.
Employers can improve staff retention by offering fair wages, flexible schedules, and opportunities for professional development.

col: a major employer｜một nhà tuyển dụng lớn
a prospective employer｜nhà tuyển dụng tiềm năng
tip: employer là người thuê lao động; employee là người làm thuê.

senses.en: To an extremely high degree.

senses.zh: khó tin là; không thể tin được
senses.en: In a way that is surprising or hard to believe.

ex.en: The soup was incredibly hot, so I waited.
Reliable public transport can be incredibly valuable to older residents who no longer drive.

tip: Thường bổ nghĩa cho tính từ hoặc trạng từ; đứng đầu câu có nghĩa “thật khó tin là”.

senses.en: A pleasant-smelling liquid applied to the body.
A pleasant smell, especially from flowers.
To give something a pleasant smell.

ex.en: She sprayed a little perfume on her wrist.
Some workplaces discourage employees from wearing perfume because strong fragrances can cause discomfort for sensitive colleagues.

col: a bottle of perfume｜một chai nước hoa
the perfume of flowers｜hương thơm của hoa
tip: Nói về việc dùng nước hoa trên người thường dùng wear perfume, không dùng put perfume.

senses.en: To move backwards and forwards or in a curved path.
A hanging seat that moves backwards and forwards.

senses.zh: sự thay đổi rõ rệt; sự dao động
senses.en: A noticeable change in an opinion, mood, or situation.

ex.en: Her bag swung gently as she walked down the street.
A sharp swing in public opinion can encourage governments to reconsider policies that previously enjoyed widespread support.

col: swing back and forth｜đung đưa qua lại
a playground swing｜xích đu sân chơi
a swing in public opinion｜sự thay đổi dư luận
tip: Quá khứ và phân từ quá khứ đều là swung, không phải swinged.

senses.en: To put money into something hoping to gain financial returns.

senses.zh: bỏ (thời gian, công sức, tiền) vào
senses.en: To devote resources to something for a future benefit.

ex.en: My aunt plans to invest in a small bakery.
Governments should invest in renewable energy to improve energy security and reduce dependence on imported fuels.

col: invest in property｜đầu tư vào bất động sản
invest heavily in｜đầu tư mạnh vào
invest time in｜bỏ thời gian vào
tip: Thường dùng invest in; bỏ thời gian làm việc gì có thể dùng invest time in doing.

senses.en: using science to design and build machines, structures, or systems

ex.en: My cousin studies engineering and builds small robots at home.
Advances in engineering have enabled cities to build bridges that withstand extreme weather and carry heavier traffic.

col: civil engineering｜kỹ thuật xây dựng dân dụng
an engineering project｜một dự án kỹ thuật
tip: Khi chỉ ngành hoặc lĩnh vực kỹ thuật thì không đếm được; engineer là kỹ sư.

senses.en: likely to damage physical or mental health
not in good physical condition
harmful or excessive in a way that causes problems

ex.en: Eating only biscuits for dinner is an unhealthy habit.
Advertising unhealthy foods to children may contribute to poor dietary habits and higher rates of obesity.

col: an unhealthy diet｜chế độ ăn không lành mạnh
an unhealthy lifestyle｜lối sống không lành mạnh
unhealthy competition｜cạnh tranh không lành mạnh
an unhealthy obsession｜nỗi ám ảnh có hại
tip: unhealthy có thể chỉ vật gây hại cho sức khỏe, hoặc thể trạng yếu kém.

senses.zh: khoa học; theo phương pháp khoa học
senses.en: relating to science or using methods based on evidence

ex.en: Our class used scientific methods to test the water.
Governments should rely on scientific evidence when developing policies to protect public health.

tip: scientific nhấn mạnh dựa trên cơ sở khoa học, không chỉ là có hệ thống.

senses.zh: sự chuẩn bị; công tác chuẩn bị
senses.en: The work done to get ready for something.

ex.en: Dinner preparation takes longer when the children help.
Thorough preparation for job interviews can help graduates communicate their skills and experience more confidently.

col: in preparation for｜để chuẩn bị cho
tip: Chuẩn bị nói chung thì không đếm được; các việc chuẩn bị cụ thể thường dùng số nhiều preparations.

senses.en: a flightless seabird with black and white feathers, found mainly south

ex.en: The penguin waddled across the rocks towards the sea.
Changes in ocean temperatures can affect penguin populations by altering the availability of fish and other prey.

tip: Chim cánh cụt là loài chim không biết bay; không phải loài nào cũng sống ở Nam Cực.

senses.zh: chuông báo động; còi báo động; đồng hồ báo thức
senses.en: A warning signal or device, or something that wakes you.
A sudden feeling of fear or worry.

senses.zh: làm hoảng sợ; làm lo lắng
senses.en: To make someone frightened or worried.

ex.en: My alarm rang before sunrise, waking the whole family.
Every school should test its fire alarm regularly to ensure that pupils receive an immediate warning.

tip: Chuông báo động kêu dùng go off, không dùng go on.

senses.en: An official document proving a fact or qualification.

ex.en: Lena proudly showed her swimming certificate to her grandparents.
A professional certificate can improve employment prospects, but employers also value practical experience.

col: a medical certificate｜giấy chứng nhận y tế
a professional certificate｜chứng chỉ chuyên môn
tip: certificate chỉ chung giấy chứng nhận hoặc chứng chỉ, không nhất thiết là bằng cấp.

senses.en: Not interesting or exciting.
Not bright or sunny.
Having an edge that does not cut easily.

ex.en: The film was so dull that I nearly fell asleep.
Lessons can seem dull when students have few opportunities to ask questions or explore ideas independently.

tip: Với lưỡi dao thì nghĩa là cùn; với hoạt động thì nghĩa là chán.

senses.en: Related to electricity or equipment that uses it.

ex.en: An electrical fault left our kitchen in darkness.
Regular inspections of electrical equipment can reduce fire risks in crowded residential buildings and workplaces.

tip: electrical thường dùng cho lĩnh vực điện; electric thường chỉ vật chạy bằng điện.

senses.zh: lời giải thích; sự giải thích
senses.en: information that makes something easier to understand

senses.zh: nguyên nhân; lý do được đưa ra
senses.en: a reason given for why something happened

ex.en: Her simple explanation helped me understand the new game.
One possible explanation for declining car ownership is the growing availability of reliable public transport.

col: clear explanation｜lời giải thích rõ ràng
give an explanation｜đưa ra lời giải thích
explanation for｜lời giải thích về nguyên nhân của
tip: explanation of thường giải thích nội dung; explanation for thường giải thích nguyên nhân.

senses.en: Before a planned event or a particular time.

ex.en: We booked our train tickets two weeks in advance.
Publishing consultation dates well in advance allows more residents to participate in local planning decisions.

tip: in advance có thể dùng độc lập; đi với một sự kiện thì dùng in advance of.

senses.zh: hằng tháng; mỗi tháng một lần
senses.en: Happening, produced, or paid once every month.
Once every month.
A magazine published once every month.

ex.en: My monthly bus pass fits neatly inside my wallet.
Monthly payments can make essential services more affordable, but households should monitor their total spending carefully.

col: monthly payments｜các khoản thanh toán hằng tháng
tip: monthly có thể là tính từ hoặc trạng từ.

senses.en: Unhappy because something was not as good as you hoped.

ex.en: I was disappointed when rain cancelled our beach picnic.
Graduates may feel disappointed if their first jobs offer few opportunities to apply the skills they have learned.

col: disappointed to hear｜thất vọng khi nghe
tip: disappointed mô tả cảm xúc của người; disappointing mô tả điều gây thất vọng.
